# One module per case, xp-<case>.yang, each with one XPath problem (or none).
# scripts/pyang-oracle.sh and scripts/yanglint-oracle.sh record whether pyang and yanglint
# reject each; test/xpath/check.test.ts checks that @node-net/yang reports the code given here,
# and agrees with both.
#   case  expected-code-or-ok
ok               ok
syntax           xpath-syntax
unbalanced       xpath-syntax
axis             xpath-syntax
prefix           xpath-unknown-prefix
function         xpath-unknown-function
arguments        xpath-arguments
variable         xpath-unknown-variable
identity-prefix  xpath-unknown-prefix
path-literal     invalid-path
path-predicate   invalid-path
path-no-up       invalid-path
lr-ok            ok
lr-not-list      leafref-invalid-predicate
lr-no-key        leafref-invalid-predicate
lr-not-key       leafref-invalid-predicate
lr-key-twice     leafref-invalid-predicate
lr-key-path      leafref-invalid-predicate
lr-key-too-high  leafref-invalid-predicate
lr-key-not-leaf  leafref-invalid-predicate
